script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
CADDY="/etc/caddy/Caddyfile"
BAK="/etc/caddy/Caddyfile.bak.frame.$(date +%s)"
sudo cp "$CADDY" "$BAK"
sudo python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = "/etc/caddy/Caddyfile"
s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
# Replace strict X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN with CSP frame-ancestors whitelisting local 8765 workbench
s = s.replace(
    'X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"',
    'Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors \'self\' http://127.0.0.1:8765 http://localhost:8765"'
)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("CADDY_FRAME_ANCESTORS_UPDATED")
PYEOF
if sudo caddy validate --config "$CADDY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo systemctl reload caddy
  echo "CADDY_RELOADED_OK"
else
  echo "CADDY_ROLLBACK"
  sudo cp "$BAK" "$CADDY"
  exit 1
fi
curl -fsSI "https://xinmo.work/" | grep -iE 'content-security-policy|x-frame-options' || true
